visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A highly detailed collectible figure of Space Godzilla is displayed on a wooden surface against a dark background illuminated by vibrant red and blue studio lighting. In the bottom left, a 3D male avatar with glasses and a black hoodie gives a thumbs-up. (2) The scene cuts to a stylized Godzilla figure with an exaggerated mouth and rows of sharp teeth. (3) A cut reveals a different Godzilla iteration featuring orange translucent dorsal fins and glowing chest segments. (4) The camera switches to a Shin Godzilla figure depicted with a massive, split lower jaw and purple internal highlights. (5) A 'Burning Godzilla' style figure is shown, characterized by intense orange and yellow patches across its dark, textured skin. (6) A unique collectible item shaped like a Godzilla foot is presented, appearing to be mounted on a wooden stand. (7) A real person, a man with glasses and a black baseball cap, enters the frame, holding up a large black tote bag featuring a white Godzilla graphic and the text 'KING OF THE MONSTERS'. The studio lighting remains consistent with split tones.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a heavy, cinematic orchestral hit, featuring dominant brass sections and resonant timpani strikes. The tempo is approximately 120 BPM with a dark, minor-key tonality. (2) A series of synchronized percussive hits occur, each marking a visual cut between the different figure displays. There are no human vocals. (3) The rhythmic hits continue with high spectral flux, maintaining a tense and epic atmosphere. (4) The track concludes with a final sustained low-frequency orchestral tension note as the real person is revealed. The audio is exceptionally clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio.
